scripts.dev:browser: bun run assets && bun run --cwd ui start --configuration browser
scripts.dev:server: bun run assets && bun run --cwd ui start --configuration server
scripts.dev:desktop: bun run assets && bun run --cwd ui start --configuration desktop
scripts.build: bun run build:browser && bun run build:server && bun run build:desktop
scripts.build:browser: bun run assets --release && bun run --cwd ui build --configuration production,browser
scripts.build:server: bun run assets --release && bun run --cwd ui build --configuration production,server
scripts.build:desktop: bun run assets --release && bun run --cwd ui build --configuration production,desktop
